# Redneck Rampage demo data

`redneck-demo.jsdos` contains the Redneck Rampage Alpha Demo Version 0.7
“Moonshine”, repackaged as a js-dos bundle. The original archive was obtained
from [DOS Games Archive](https://www.dosgamesarchive.com/file/redneck-rampage/redneckd).

The bundle retains the original `HELPYALL.TXT` and other demo files. `REDNECK.GRP`
files from full-game installations and other local game data remain ignored.

The bundle includes `REDNECK.CFG`, generated by the demo's setup utility with
640×480 VESA 2.0 graphics and keyboard-plus-mouse controls, so a first visit
launches `REDNECK.EXE` directly instead of stopping at its setup menu. Rebuild
it with `python3 tools/repack_redneck_demo.py <demo-archive.zip> <output.jsdos>`.
